question: Does historical cost-sensitive decision selection add genuine action accuracy or regret value on the symmetric benchmark and current valid policy set?

headline: RESOURCE_PRESERVING_V1
NEXUS_SELECTOR_V1
OBJECTIVE_TARGETING_V1
THREAT_COVERING_V1
policySet.V2: diagnostic only: shortcut-dependent under P.1E and P.1-SYM
policySet.RESOURCE: retained as the required best-single comparator and fallback despite its cost shortcut; selecting it more often is not attributed to genuine rule value unless the rule beats both it and the cascade and passes the nuisance audit

methodology.routerSource: frozen Stage 3F.6-T router (weights from its evaluation freeze); not retrained
methodology.regimeDefinition: soft best-policy membership: 1/|best set| for each policy at minimum regret
methodology.classWeights: DEV only: w_k = 1 / max(prior_k, 1/n_dev), normalised to sum to 1 over routed policies
methodology.costMatrix: DEV only: mean realized regret of the selected policy, weighted by soft regime membership
methodology.valueMatrix: DEV only: mean correctness of the selected policy, weighted by soft regime membership
methodology.emptyCellPolicy: a cost/value cell with no DEV support falls back to the selected policy's overall DEV mean (frozen, recorded)
methodology.probabilityCalibration: temperature scaling of router probabilities; T chosen on CAL by minimum soft-target cross-entropy
methodology.nexusThresholdRule: on CAL: minimise mean regret; ties -> higher accuracy -> higher threshold
methodology.headlineRuleSelection: on CAL, among B/C/D/E: minimum mean regret; ties -> higher accuracy -> DecisionRule order

claims: expected-regret slightly lowers HOLDOUT regret but is below materiality
class weighting increases specialist capture and harm
expected-value headline selects RESOURCE 96.2% HOLDOUT and 98.8% OOD
NEXUS false selections offset much of capture value
RESOURCE dominates as a simple baseline
OOD benefit vanishes as selection collapses

fitting.router: frozen Stage 3F.6-T multinomial logistic methodology refitted on symmetric DEV only; no larger model
fitting.features: DEPLOYABLE_CORE, same audited 30 features as T-SYM
fitting.matrices: historical D cost, value, and inverse-prior class-weight formulas on DEV only; full matrices and hash fixed in analysis freeze
fitting.temperature: historical grid, CAL soft-target cross-entropy; tie lower temperature
fitting.nexusThreshold: historical grid, CAL minimum raw regret; tie higher accuracy then higher threshold
fitting.bestSingle: always-available headline policy with least DEV+CAL mean regret
fitting.cascade: T-SYM headline cascade CAL procedure: specialist CAL accuracy when proposing exceeds best single, descending accuracy, then best single
fitting.abstention: historical D rules select whenever any policy proposes; no confidence threshold is added; no available policy means ABSTAIN

rules.ARGMAX_ROUTER: historical A: argmax calibrated policy probability
rules.EXPECTED_REGRET_ROUTER: historical C: minimum sum P(regime) * DEV mean regret for selected policy
rules.CLASS_WEIGHTED_ROUTER: historical B: argmax P(policy) * inverse DEV soft-regime prior
rules.EXPECTED_VALUE_ROUTER: historical D: maximum sum P(regime) * DEV mean action correctness (diagnostic comparison)
rules.NEXUS_THRESHOLD_ROUTER: historical E: NEXUS override at CAL threshold, else argmax (diagnostic comparison)
rules.W_ENRICHED_ROUTER: diagnostic only if W-SYM valid deployable risk set and committed W model can be scored on identical decision-time evidence; otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE with reason
rules.PERFECT_SELECTOR_REFERENCE: oracle minimum regret among proposing headline policies, for headroom only

metrics.actionAccuracy: correct action / all episodes; abstention is incorrect
metrics.meanRegret: mean raw regret / all episodes; abstention has null regret and is separately counted
metrics.normalizedRegret: regret / maximum action regret for that episode, 0 if all actions optimal
metrics.falseSelection: per specialist relative to RESOURCE on episodes selected: savedCorrect=sum max(0,R-S) when specialist is in the minimum-regret best set; savedPartial=sum max(0,R-S) otherwise; addedFalse=sum max(0,S-R) when specialist is outside the best set; net=savedCorrect+savedPartial-addedFalse; false rate=outside best set
metrics.latency: wall-clock microseconds reported outside certification hash; no latency claim when host contention prevents stable measurement
metrics.paired: 1000 seeded bootstrap resamples; report accuracy, raw and normalized regret CI versus BEST_SINGLE and CASCADE

decisionCriteria.material: accuracy gain >= .02 with paired CI lower >0 and normalized regret not significantly worse, OR normalized regret reduction >= .02 with paired CI upper <0 and accuracy not significantly worse
decisionCriteria.mixedTradeoff: statistically better regret and statistically worse accuracy (or reverse) is TRADEOFF, never improvement
decisionCriteria.catastrophicGuard: catastrophic error may not increase with paired 95% CI lower >0
decisionCriteria.collapse: top policy share > .9; pathological when also > its best-set share + .05; never claim mixture value when collapsed
decisionCriteria.falseHarm: specialist net >=0, episodes worsened <= improved, and false-selection p95 added <= BEST_SINGLE p95 regret
decisionCriteria.ood: SURVIVES only if material HOLDOUT value persists on OOD with no significantly worse accuracy, normalized regret, or catastrophic rate; DEGRADES if benefit attenuates without significant reversal; COLLAPSES if top share > .9; REVERSES if significantly worse; else INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
decisionCriteria.promotion: no future Router work unless one metric is material vs both BEST_SINGLE and CASCADE with no significant worsening of the other, OOD survives, harm acceptable, no collapse, and the perfect selector reaches >= .5 action accuracy on both fresh partitions

historicalClaimRules.expectedRegretAdvantage: SURVIVES if expected-regret is material vs BEST_SINGLE; PARTIALLY_SURVIVES if raw regret is merely lower; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaimRules.classWeightingEffect: SURVIVES if class-weighted normalized regret is higher than BEST_SINGLE; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaimRules.nexusCapture: SURVIVES if expected-regret selects NEXUS less often than argmax, as historical cost-sensitive D did; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaimRules.falseSelectionHarm: SURVIVES if headline NEXUS false-selection added regret >= correctly selected savings; PARTIALLY_SURVIVES if nonzero but smaller; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaimRules.resourceDominance: SURVIVES if RESOURCE is CAL best single and no headline rule is material vs it; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaimRules.oodSurvival: SURVIVES only for the strict OOD criterion; PARTIALLY_SURVIVES for a collapsed but non-reversed rule; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaimRules.materiality: SURVIVES when no headline rule meets the materiality, OOD, collapse, harm and nuisance gates; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaimRules.collapse: SURVIVES when top share exceeds .9 on HOLDOUT or OOD; else INVALIDATED

audits.D4: rule choice maps on P.1D stored D4 twins where policies and CORE are invariant
audits.ID: P.1E relabel evidence and fresh D-SYM mutation sample
audits.candidateOrder: reverse candidate presentation with decision-time features and policy availability held equal
audits.orientation: report per-orientation accuracy/regret and max gap
audits.nuisanceValue: headline rule must have exact decision-choice D4, ID, and candidate-order invariance on the predeclared first 64 equivariance rows per fresh partition; its mutation accuracy delta may differ from BEST_SINGLE by at most .02 for D4 and ID. Otherwise value is nuisance-dependent and excluded from materiality

acceptance: PASS when all integrity, deterministic replay, predecessor, symmetry, and measurement checks pass, including a scientifically negative result
